verdicts.reason: In both, the logo is blown up to about the attribution's height and sits right beside it, so it competes with the quote. The SOLSTICE can label is also too small to read, and the circle is a full disc floating loose instead of the original's cropped corner arc. A is worse: 'THE ULTRA TASTING TEAM' is shrunk to a barely legible size, making the logo the louder element on that line. B keeps the attribution readable and wraps the quote more evenly, though its logo is still far too dominant.
